Small adventures.
Clear boundaries.

Your family's privacy

The free adventure is a grown-up-led activity. There are no child accounts, ads, analytics scripts, or email forms. An optional nickname personalises the story in this browser tab. We do not send it to a server or save it in browser storage. Reloading or closing the page resets the adventure.

Your browser requests the site's files, including the story JSON and PDFs. Hosting providers may process normal request information such as IP addresses and access times. Downloaded keepsakes and PDFs remain on your device until you remove them. If you type a child's name into a keepsake, think about where you share that file.

Play, with a grown-up

These activities are suggestions for ages 3–7, not assessments or developmental promises. Read them first and choose what fits your child. Every activity has a seated option. No climbing, blindfolding, racing, food, water, scissors, beads or small loose craft pieces are needed. Keep materials and paper scraps away from younger siblings and supervise play.

Quiet mode substitutes pointing, drawing and silent gestures for sound. It is not a guarantee that a child will be quiet or that an activity will suit every sensory preference. Stop, skip or change anything that doesn't feel good.

A real city, imaginary stories

Piku, his friends, the missing postcard and the secret signals are original fiction. The illustration is an imaginary home-built city inspired by Hyderabad, not an accurate architectural drawing. The only historical or geographic statements in the kit are small, explicitly marked city facts.

  • Charminar is a Hyderabad landmark with four minarets.
  • Golconda is a fort in Hyderabad.
  • Hussain Sagar is a lake between Hyderabad and Secunderabad.

The adventures happen at home. We do not provide routes, opening hours or safety advice for visiting the actual places.

The first edition

The free adventure and its PDF are available without registration. The full Hyderabad at Home PDF pack has been produced, but sales are closed while the edition is playtested. ₹299 is a proposed one-time family price, not an active checkout. We aren't accepting preorders, collecting payment details, or promising a launch date.

Stories are written in English with optional short Hinglish lines. This is not a complete Hindi or Telugu edition. No claims of child testing, expert endorsement, or learning outcomes have been made.

Using the material

Free sample: print and replay with your household, and share the link with friends. Full pack: intended for one household; classroom, commercial party and resale rights are not included. School and group editions would need their own terms before being offered.
